verses.original: וַיֶּאֶסֹ֧ף יְהוֹשֻׁ֛עַ אֶת־ כָּל־ שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל שְׁכֶ֑מָה וַיִּקְרָא֩ לְזִקְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל וּלְרָאשָׁ֗יו וּלְשֹֽׁפְטָיו֙ וּלְשֹׁ֣טְרָ֔יו וַיִּֽתְיַצְּב֖וּ לִפְנֵ֥י הָאֱלֹהִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ye·’e·sōp̄ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- kāl- šiḇ·ṭê yiś·rā·’êl šə·ḵe·māh way·yiq·rā lə·ziq·nê yiś·rā·’êl ū·lə·rā·šāw ū·lə·šō·p̄ə·ṭāw ū·lə·šō·ṭə·rāw way·yiṯ·yaṣ·ṣə·ḇū lip̄·nê hā·’ĕ·lō·hîm
verses.literal: Then Joshua assembled all the tribes of Israel at Shechem He summoned the elders leaders judges and officers of Israel and they presented themselves before God
verses.literalPt: Josué reuniu todas as tribos de Israel em Siquém e chamou os anciãos de Israel, os seus cabeças, os seus juízes e os seus oficiais; e eles se apresentaram diante de Deus.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם כֹּֽה־ אָמַ֣ר יְהוָה֮ אֱלֹהֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֗ר יָשְׁב֤וּ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מֵֽעוֹלָ֔ם תֶּ֛רַח אֲבִ֥י אַבְרָהָ֖ם וַאֲבִ֣י נָח֑וֹר וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām kōh- ’ā·mar Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl bə·‘ê·ḇer han·nā·hār yā·šə·ḇū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem mê·‘ō·w·lām te·raḥ ’ă·ḇî ’aḇ·rā·hām wa·’ă·ḇî nā·ḥō·wr way·ya·‘aḇ·ḏū ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm
verses.literal: And Joshua said to all the people This is what the LORD the God of Israel says Long ago your fathers including Terah the father of Abraham . . . and Nahor lived beyond the Euphrates and worshiped other gods
verses.literalPt: Josué disse a todo o povo: Assim diz Jeová, Deus de Israel: Além do rio, antigamente habitaram vossos pais, Tera, pai de Abraão e pai de Naor, e serviram a outros deuses.

verses.original: וָ֠אֶקַּח אֶת־ אֲבִיכֶ֤ם אֶת־ אַבְרָהָם֙ מֵעֵ֣בֶר הַנָּהָ֔ר וָאוֹלֵ֥ךְ אוֹת֖וֹ בְּכָל־ אֶ֣רֶץ כְּנָ֑עַן וָאֶרֶב אֶת־ זַרְע֔וֹ וָֽאֶתֶּן־ ל֖וֹ אֶת־ יִצְחָֽק׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eq·qaḥ ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇî·ḵem ’eṯ- ’aḇ·rā·hām mê·‘ê·ḇer han·nā·hār wā·’ō·w·lêḵ ’ō·w·ṯōw bə·ḵāl ’e·reṣ kə·nā·‘an wå̄·ʾɛ·rɛḇ ’eṯ- zar·‘ōw wā·’et·ten- lōw ’eṯ- yiṣ·ḥāq
verses.literal: But I took your father Abraham from beyond the Euphrates and led him through all the land of Canaan and I multiplied his descendants I gave him Isaac
verses.literalPt: E tirei a vosso pai Abraão dalém do rio, e o fiz andar por toda a terra de Canaã, e multipliquei a sua semente, e dei-lhe Isaque.

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֣ן לְיִצְחָ֔ק אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְאֶת־ עֵשָׂ֑ו וָאֶתֵּ֨ן לְעֵשָׂ֜ו אֶת־ הַ֤ר שֵׂעִיר֙ לָרֶ֣שֶׁת אוֹת֔וֹ וְיַעֲקֹ֥ב וּבָנָ֖יו יָרְד֥וּ מִצְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên lə·yiṣ·ḥāq ’eṯ- ya·‘ă·qōḇ wə·’eṯ- ‘ê·śāw wā·’et·tên lə·‘ê·śāw ’eṯ- har śê·‘îr lā·re·šeṯ ’ō·w·ṯōw wə·ya·‘ă·qōḇ ū·ḇā·nāw yā·rə·ḏū miṣ·rā·yim
verses.literal: and to Isaac I gave Jacob and Esau I gave Esau Mount Seir to possess but Jacob and his sons went down to Egypt
verses.literalPt: A Isaque dei Jacó e Esaú; e a Esaú dei o monte Seir para o possuir. Jacó e seus filhos desceram ao Egito.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֞ח אֶת־ מֹשֶׁ֤ה וְאֶֽת־ אַהֲרֹן֙ וָאֶגֹּ֣ף אֶת־ מִצְרַ֔יִם כַּאֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּקִרְבּ֑וֹ וְאַחַ֖ר הוֹצֵ֥אתִי אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·laḥ ’eṯ- mō·šeh wə·’eṯ- ’a·hă·rōn wā·’eg·gōp̄ ’eṯ- miṣ·ra·yim ka·’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî bə·qir·bōw wə·’a·ḥar hō·w·ṣê·ṯî ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: Then I sent Moses and Aaron and I afflicted the Egyptians by what I did there and afterward I brought you out
verses.literalPt: Então, mandei Moisés e Arão, e feri ao Egito com pragas, conforme tudo o que fiz ali, e, depois, vos tirei de lá.

verses.original: וָֽאוֹצִ֤יא אֶת־ אֲבֽוֹתֵיכֶם֙ מִמִּצְרַ֔יִם וַתָּבֹ֖אוּ הַיָּ֑מָּה וַיִּרְדְּפ֨וּ מִצְרַ֜יִם אַחֲרֵ֧י אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֛ם בְּרֶ֥כֶב וּבְפָרָשִׁ֖ים יַם־ סֽוּף׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’ō·w·ṣî ’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem mim·miṣ·ra·yim wat·tā·ḇō·’ū hay·yām·māh way·yir·də·p̄ū miṣ·ra·yim ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·re·ḵeḇ ū·ḇə·p̄ā·rā·šîm yam- sūp̄
verses.literal: When I brought your fathers out of Egypt and you reached the Red Sea the Egyptians pursued . . . them with chariots and horsemen as far as the Red Sea . . .
verses.literalPt: Tirei do Egito a vossos pais, e viestes ao mar; os egípcios perseguiram a vossos pais com carros e com cavalheiros até o mar Vermelho.

verses.original: וַיִּצְעֲק֣וּ אֶל־ יְהוָ֗ה וַיָּ֨שֶׂם מַֽאֲפֵ֜ל בֵּינֵיכֶ֣ם׀ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּצְרִ֗ים וַיָּבֵ֨א עָלָ֤יו אֶת־ הַיָּם֙ וַיְכַסֵּ֔הוּ וַתִּרְאֶ֙ינָה֙ עֵינֵיכֶ֔ם אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ עָשִׂ֖יתִי בְּמִצְרָ֑יִם וַתֵּשְׁב֥וּ בַמִּדְבָּ֖ר יָמִ֥ים רַבִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiṣ·‘ă·qū ’el- Yah·weh way·yā·śem ma·’ă·p̄êl bê·nê·ḵem ū·ḇên ham·miṣ·rîm way·yā·ḇê ‘ā·lāw ’eṯ- hay·yām way·ḵas·sê·hū wat·tir·’e·nāh ‘ê·nê·ḵem ’êṯ ’ă·šer- ‘ā·śî·ṯî bə·miṣ·rā·yim wat·tê·šə·ḇū ḇam·miḏ·bār yā·mîm rab·bîm
verses.literal: So your fathers cried out to the LORD and He put darkness between . . . you and the Egyptians over whom He brought the sea and engulfed them Your very eyes saw what I did to the Egyptians Then you lived in the wilderness for a long time
verses.literalPt: Quando clamaram a Jeová, pôs ele trevas entre vós e os egípcios, e trouxe o mar sobre eles, e os cobriu; e os vossos olhos viram o que fiz no Egito. Habitastes no deserto muitos dias.

verses.original: וָאָבִאָה אֶתְכֶ֗ם אֶל־ אֶ֤רֶץ הָאֱמֹרִי֙ הַיּוֹשֵׁב֙ בְּעֵ֣בֶר הַיַּרְדֵּ֔ן וַיִּֽלָּחֲמ֖וּ אִתְּכֶ֑ם וָאֶתֵּ֨ן אוֹתָ֤ם בְּיֶדְכֶם֙ וַתִּֽירְשׁ֣וּ אֶת־ אַרְצָ֔ם וָאַשְׁמִידֵ֖ם מִפְּנֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wå̄·ʾå̄·ḇi·ʾå̄h ’eṯ·ḵem ’el- ’e·reṣ hā·’ĕ·mō·rî hay·yō·wō·šêḇ bə·‘ê·ḇer hay·yar·dên way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū ’it·tə·ḵem wā·’et·tên ’ō·w·ṯām bə·yeḏ·ḵem wat·tî·rə·šū ’eṯ- ’ar·ṣām wā·’aš·mî·ḏêm mip·pə·nê·ḵem
verses.literal: Later, I brought you to the land of the Amorites who lived beyond the Jordan They fought against you but I delivered them into your hand that you should possess their land when I destroyed them before you
verses.literalPt: Eu vos trouxe para a terra dos amorreus, que habitavam além do Jordão; e, pelejando eles contra vós, entreguei-os nas vossas mãos, e possuístes a sua terra; e destruí-os de diante de vós.

verses.original: וַיָּ֨קָם בָּלָ֤ק בֶּן־ צִפּוֹר֙ מֶ֣לֶךְ מוֹאָ֔ב וַיִּלָּ֖חֶם בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וַיִּשְׁלַ֗ח וַיִּקְרָ֛א לְבִלְעָ֥ם בֶּן־ בְּע֖וֹר לְקַלֵּ֥ל אֶתְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yā·qām bā·lāq ben- ṣip·pō·wr me·leḵ mō·w·’āḇ way·yil·lā·ḥem bə·yiś·rā·’êl way·yiš·laḥ way·yiq·rā lə·ḇil·‘ām ben- bə·‘ō·wr lə·qal·lêl ’eṯ·ḵem
verses.literal: Then Balak son of Zippor the king of Moab set out to fight against Israel He sent . . . for Balaam son of Beor to curse you
verses.literalPt: Balaque, filho de Zipor, rei de Moabe, levantou-se e pelejou contra Israel. Mandou chamar a Balaão, filho de Beor, para que vos amaldiçoasse,

verses.original: וְלֹ֥א אָבִ֖יתִי לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ לְבִלְעָ֑ם וַיְבָ֤רֶךְ בָּרוֹךְ֙ אֶתְכֶ֔ם וָאַצִּ֥ל אֶתְכֶ֖ם מִיָּדֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: wə·lō ’ā·ḇî·ṯî liš·mō·a‘ lə·ḇil·‘ām way·ḇā·reḵ bā·rō·wḵ ’eṯ·ḵem wā·’aṣ·ṣil ’eṯ·ḵem mî·yā·ḏōw
verses.literal: but I would not listen to Balaam So he blessed you again and again . . . . . . and I delivered you from his hand
verses.literalPt: porém eu não quis ouvir a Balaão; portanto, ele vos abençoou grandemente. Assim, vos livrei das suas mãos.

verses.original: וַתַּעַבְר֣וּ אֶת־ הַיַּרְדֵּן֮ וַתָּבֹ֣אוּ אֶל־ יְרִיחוֹ֒ וַיִּלָּחֲמ֣וּ בָכֶ֣ם בַּעֲלֵֽי־ יְ֠רִיחוֹ הָֽאֱמֹרִ֨י וְהַפְּרִזִּ֜י וְהַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֗י וְהַֽחִתִּי֙ וְהַגִּרְגָּשִׁ֔י הַֽחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִ֑י וָאֶתֵּ֥ן אוֹתָ֖ם בְּיֶדְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: wat·ta·‘aḇ·rū ’eṯ- hay·yar·dên wat·tā·ḇō·’ū ’el- yə·rî·ḥōw way·yil·lā·ḥă·mū ḇā·ḵem ba·‘ă·lê- yə·rî·ḥōw hā·’ĕ·mō·rî wə·hap·pə·riz·zî wə·hak·kə·na·‘ă·nî wə·ha·ḥit·tî wə·hag·gir·gā·šî ha·ḥiw·wî wə·hay·ḇū·sî wā·’et·tên ’ō·w·ṯām bə·yeḏ·ḵem
verses.literal: After this, you crossed the Jordan and came to Jericho The people of Jericho fought against you as did the Amorites Perizzites Canaanites Hittites Girgashites Hivites and Jebusites and I delivered them into your hand
verses.literalPt: Passastes o Jordão e viestes a Jericó. Pelejaram contra vós os homens de Jericó, os amorreus, os ferezeus, os cananeus, os heteus, os girgaseus, os heveus e os jebuseus; e entreguei-os nas vossas mãos.

verses.original: וָאֶשְׁלַ֤ח לִפְנֵיכֶם֙ אֶת־ הַצִּרְעָ֔ה וַתְּגָ֤רֶשׁ אוֹתָם֙ מִפְּנֵיכֶ֔ם שְׁנֵ֖י מַלְכֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֑י לֹ֥א בְחַרְבְּךָ֖ וְלֹ֥א בְקַשְׁתֶּֽךָ׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’eš·laḥ lip̄·nê·ḵem ’eṯ- haṣ·ṣir·‘āh wat·tə·ḡā·reš ’ō·w·ṯām mip·pə·nê·ḵem šə·nê mal·ḵê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî lō ḇə·ḥar·bə·ḵā wə·lō ḇə·qaš·te·ḵā
verses.literal: I sent the hornet ahead of you and it drove out the two Amorite kings before you but not by your own sword . . . or bow
verses.literalPt: Enviei vespas à vossa frente, que expulsaram de diante de vós os dois reis dos amorreus, não com a tua espada, nem com o teu arco.

verses.original: וָאֶתֵּ֨ן לָכֶ֜ם אֶ֣רֶץ׀ אֲשֶׁ֧ר לֹֽא־ יָגַ֣עְתָּ בָּ֗הּ וְעָרִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹא־ בְנִיתֶ֔ם וַתֵּשְׁב֖וּ בָּהֶ֑ם כְּרָמִ֤ים וְזֵיתִים֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־ נְטַעְתֶּ֔ם אַתֶּ֖ם אֹכְלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: wā·’et·tên lā·ḵem ’e·reṣ ’ă·šer lō- yā·ḡa‘·tā bāh wə·‘ā·rîm ’ă·šer lō- ḇə·nî·ṯem wat·tê·šə·ḇū bā·hem kə·rā·mîm wə·zê·ṯîm ’ă·šer lō- nə·ṭa‘·tem ’at·tem ’ō·ḵə·lîm
verses.literal: So I gave you a land on which you did not toil and cities that you did not build and now you live in them and eat from vineyards and olive groves that you did not plant
verses.literalPt: Eu vos dei uma terra que não trabalhastes e cidades que não edificastes, e nelas habitais; comeis de vinhas e olivais que não plantastes.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֞ה יְר֧אוּ אֶת־ יְהוָ֛ה וְעִבְד֥וּ אֹת֖וֹ בְּתָמִ֣ים וּבֶֽאֱמֶ֑ת וְהָסִ֣ירוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהִ֗ים אֲשֶׁר֩ עָבְד֨וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֜ם בְּעֵ֤בֶר הַנָּהָר֙ וּבְמִצְרַ֔יִם וְעִבְד֖וּ אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh yə·r·’ū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wə·‘iḇ·ḏū ’ō·ṯōw bə·ṯā·mîm ū·ḇe·’ĕ·meṯ wə·hā·sî·rū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇə·ḏū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem bə·‘ê·ḇer han·nā·hār ū·ḇə·miṣ·ra·yim wə·‘iḇ·ḏū ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: Now, therefore fear the LORD and serve Him in sincerity and truth cast aside the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates and in Egypt and serve the LORD
verses.literalPt: Agora, temei a Jeová e servi-o com sinceridade e com verdade. Deitai fora os deuses a que vossos pais serviram além do rio e no Egito e servi a Jeová.

verses.original: וְאִם֩ רַ֨ע בְּֽעֵינֵיכֶ֜ם לַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֗ה בַּחֲר֨וּ לָכֶ֣ם הַיּוֹם֮ אֶת־ מִ֣י תַעֲבֹדוּן֒ אִ֣ם אֶת־ אֱלֹהִ֞ים אֲשֶׁר־ עָבְד֣וּ אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֗ם אֲשֶׁר֙ בְּעֵבֶר הַנָּהָ֔ר וְאִם֙ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֣י הָאֱמֹרִ֔י אֲשֶׁ֥ר אַתֶּ֖ם יֹשְׁבִ֣ים בְּאַרְצָ֑ם וְאָנֹכִ֣י וּבֵיתִ֔י נַעֲבֹ֖ד אֶת־ יְהוָֽה׃פ
verses.transliteration: wə·’im ra‘ bə·‘ê·nê·ḵem la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ba·ḥă·rū lā·ḵem hay·yō·wm ’eṯ- mî ṯa·‘ă·ḇō·ḏūn ’im ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·šer- ‘ā·ḇə·ḏū ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·ḵem ’ă·šer bə·ʿē·ḇɛr han·nā·hār wə·’im ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê hā·’ĕ·mō·rî ’ă·šer ’at·tem yō·šə·ḇîm bə·’ar·ṣām wə·’ā·nō·ḵî ū·ḇê·ṯî na·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh
verses.literal: But if it is unpleasing in your sight to serve the LORD then choose for yourselves this day whom you will serve whether the gods your fathers served beyond the Euphrates or the gods of the Amorites in whose land you are living As for me and my house we will serve the LORD
verses.literalPt: Se vos parece mal o servirdes a Jeová, escolhei hoje a quem haveis de servir: se aos deuses a quem serviram vossos pais além do rio ou aos deuses dos amorreus, em cuja terra habitais. Eu e minha casa, porém, havemos de servir a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיַּ֤עַן הָעָם֙ וַיֹּ֔אמֶר חָלִ֣ילָה לָּ֔נוּ מֵעֲזֹ֖ב אֶת־ יְהוָ֑ה לַעֲבֹ֖ד אֱלֹהִ֥ים אֲחֵרִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘an hā·‘ām way·yō·mer ḥā·lî·lāh lā·nū mê·‘ă·zōḇ ’eṯ- Yah·weh la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’ĕ·lō·hîm ’ă·ḥê·rîm
verses.literal: The people . . . replied Far be it from us to forsake the LORD to serve other gods
verses.literalPt: O povo respondeu: Longe de nós o abandonarmos a Jeová, para servirmos outros deuses;

verses.original: כִּ֚י יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֵ֔ינוּ הוּא֩ הַמַּעֲלֶ֨ה אֹתָ֧נוּ וְאֶת־ אֲבוֹתֵ֛ינוּ מֵאֶ֥רֶץ מִצְרַ֖יִם מִבֵּ֣ית עֲבָדִ֑ים וַאֲשֶׁ֧ר עָשָׂ֣ה לְעֵינֵ֗ינוּ אֶת־ הָאֹת֤וֹת הַגְּדֹלוֹת֙ הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַֽיִּשְׁמְרֵ֗נוּ בְּכָל־ הַדֶּ֙רֶךְ֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הָלַ֣כְנוּ בָ֔הּ וּבְכֹל֙ הָֽעַמִּ֔ים אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָבַ֖רְנוּ בְּקִרְבָּֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū hū ham·ma·‘ă·leh ’ō·ṯā·nū wə·’eṯ- ’ă·ḇō·w·ṯê·nū mê·’e·reṣ miṣ·ra·yim mib·bêṯ ‘ă·ḇā·ḏîm wa·’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·‘ê·nê·nū ’eṯ- hā·’ō·ṯō·wṯ hag·gə·ḏō·lō·wṯ hā·’êl·leh way·yiš·mə·rê·nū bə·ḵāl had·de·reḵ ’ă·šer hā·laḵ·nū ḇāh ū·ḇə·ḵōl hā·‘am·mîm ’ă·šer ‘ā·ḇar·nū bə·qir·bām
verses.literal: For the LORD our God . . . brought us and our fathers out of the land of Egypt out of the house of slavery and performed these great signs before our eyes He also protected us throughout our journey and among all the nations through which we traveled . . .
verses.literalPt: porque Jeová, nosso Deus, é quem nos tirou a nós e nossos pais da terra do Egito, da casa da servidão, quem fez todos aqueles grandes milagres à nossa vista e nos preservou em todo o caminho em que andamos e entre todos os povos pelo meio dos quais passamos.

verses.original: וַיְגָ֨רֶשׁ יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־ כָּל־ הָעַמִּ֗ים וְאֶת־ הָאֱמֹרִ֛י יֹשֵׁ֥ב הָאָ֖רֶץ מִפָּנֵ֑ינוּ גַּם־ אֲנַ֙חְנוּ֙ נַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּי־ ה֖וּא אֱלֹהֵֽינוּ׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·ḡā·reš Yah·weh ’eṯ- kāl- hā·‘am·mîm wə·’eṯ- hā·’ĕ·mō·rî yō·šêḇ hā·’ā·reṣ mip·pā·nê·nū gam- ’ă·naḥ·nū na·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh kî- hū ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū
verses.literal: And the LORD drove out before us all the nations including the Amorites who lived in the land We too will serve the LORD because He is our God
verses.literalPt: Jeová expulsou de diante de nós todos os povos, mesmo os amorreus, que habitavam na terra. Portanto, nós também havemos de servir a Jeová, pois ele é o nosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ הָעָ֗ם לֹ֤א תֽוּכְלוּ֙ לַעֲבֹ֣ד אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כִּֽי־ אֱלֹהִ֥ים קְדֹשִׁ֖ים ה֑וּא אֵֽל־ קַנּ֣וֹא ה֔וּא לֹֽא־ יִשָּׂ֥א לְפִשְׁעֲכֶ֖ם וּלְחַטֹּאותֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- hā·‘ām lō ṯū·ḵə·lū la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’eṯ- Yah·weh kî- ’ĕ·lō·hîm qə·ḏō·šîm hū ’êl- qan·nō·w hū lō- yiś·śā lə·p̄iš·‘ă·ḵem ū·lə·ḥaṭ·ṭō·w·ṯê·ḵem
verses.literal: But Joshua said to the people You are not able to serve the LORD for He is a holy God He is a jealous God He will not forgive your rebellion or your sins
verses.literalPt: Disse Josué ao povo: Não podeis servir a Jeová, porque ele é Deus santo. Ele é Deus zeloso; não perdoará a vossa transgressão nem os vossos pecados.

verses.original: כִּ֤י תַֽעַזְבוּ֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה וַעֲבַדְתֶּ֖ם אֱלֹהֵ֣י נֵכָ֑ר וְשָׁ֨ב וְהֵרַ֤ע לָכֶם֙ וְכִלָּ֣ה אֶתְכֶ֔ם אַחֲרֵ֖י אֲשֶׁר־ הֵיטִ֥יב לָכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: kî ṯa·‘az·ḇū ’eṯ- Yah·weh wa·‘ă·ḇaḏ·tem ’ĕ·lō·hê nê·ḵār wə·šāḇ wə·hê·ra‘ lā·ḵem wə·ḵil·lāh ’eṯ·ḵem ’a·ḥă·rê ’ă·šer- hê·ṭîḇ lā·ḵem
verses.literal: If you forsake the LORD and serve foreign gods He will turn and bring disaster on you and consume you even after He has been good to you
verses.literalPt: Se abandonardes a Jeová e servirdes a deuses estranhos, ele se tornará, vos fará o mal e vos consumirá, depois de vos ter feito o bem.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ לֹ֕א כִּ֥י אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה נַעֲבֹֽד׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer hā·‘ām ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ lō kî ’eṯ- Yah·weh na·‘ă·ḇōḏ
verses.literal: No . . . replied the people . . . We will serve the LORD
verses.literalPt: Disse o povo a Josué: Não. Porém havemos de servir a Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ הָעָ֗ם עֵדִ֤ים אַתֶּם֙ בָּכֶ֔ם כִּֽי־ אַתֶּ֞ם בְּחַרְתֶּ֥ם לָכֶ֛ם אֶת־ יְהוָ֖ה לַעֲבֹ֣ד אוֹת֑וֹ וַיֹּאמְר֖וּ עֵדִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- hā·‘ām ‘ê·ḏîm ’at·tem bā·ḵem kî- ’at·tem bə·ḥar·tem lā·ḵem ’eṯ- Yah·weh la·‘ă·ḇōḏ ’ō·w·ṯōw way·yō·mə·rū ‘ê·ḏîm
verses.literal: Then Joshua . . . told them You are witnesses against yourselves that you have chosen to serve the LORD We are witnesses they said
verses.literalPt: Josué respondeu ao povo: Sois testemunhas contra vós mesmos de que escolhestes a Jeová para o servir. Responderam: Somos testemunhas.

verses.original: וְעַתָּ֕ה הָסִ֛ירוּ אֶת־ אֱלֹהֵ֥י הַנֵּכָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּקִרְבְּכֶ֑ם וְהַטּוּ֙ אֶת־ לְבַבְכֶ֔ם אֶל־ יְהוָ֖ה אֱלֹהֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: wə·‘at·tāh hā·sî·rū ’eṯ- ’ĕ·lō·hê han·nê·ḵār ’ă·šer bə·qir·bə·ḵem wə·haṭ·ṭū ’eṯ- lə·ḇaḇ·ḵem ’el- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Now, therefore,” he said, get rid of the foreign gods among you and incline your hearts to the LORD the God of Israel
verses.literalPt: Agora, disse Josué, deitai fora os deuses estranhos que estão no meio de vós e inclinai os vossos corações para Jeová, Deus de Israel.

verses.original: וַיֹּאמְר֥וּ הָעָ֖ם אֶל־ יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ אֶת־ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֵ֙ינוּ֙ נַעֲבֹ֔ד וּבְקוֹל֖וֹ נִשְׁמָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mə·rū hā·‘ām ’el- yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- Yah·weh ’ĕ·lō·hê·nū na·‘ă·ḇōḏ ū·ḇə·qō·w·lōw niš·mā‘
verses.literal: So the people said to Joshua We will serve the LORD our God and obey His voice
verses.literalPt: O povo disse a Josué: Havemos de servir a Jeová, nosso Deus, e obedecer à sua voz.

verses.original: וַיִּכְרֹ֨ת יְהוֹשֻׁ֧עַ בְּרִ֛ית לָעָ֖ם בַּיּ֣וֹם הַה֑וּא וַיָּ֥שֶׂם ל֛וֹ חֹ֥ק וּמִשְׁפָּ֖ט בִּשְׁכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·rōṯ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bə·rîṯ lā·‘ām bay·yō·wm ha·hū way·yā·śem lōw ḥōq ū·miš·pāṭ biš·ḵem
verses.literal: On that day Joshua made a covenant for the people and there at Shechem he established for them a statute and ordinance
verses.literalPt: Fez Josué, nesse dia, aliança com o povo e pôs-lhe um estatuto e uma ordenança em Siquém.

verses.original: וַיִּכְתֹּ֤ב יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה בְּסֵ֖פֶר תּוֹרַ֣ת אֱלֹהִ֑ים וַיִּקַּח֙ אֶ֣בֶן גְּדוֹלָ֔ה וַיְקִימֶ֣הָ שָּׁ֔ם תַּ֚חַת הָֽאַלָּ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֖ר בְּמִקְדַּ֥שׁ יְהוָֽה׃ס
verses.transliteration: way·yiḵ·tōḇ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh bə·sê·p̄er tō·w·raṯ ’ĕ·lō·hîm way·yiq·qaḥ ’e·ḇen gə·ḏō·w·lāh way·qî·me·hā šām ta·ḥaṯ hā·’al·lāh ’ă·šer bə·miq·daš Yah·weh
verses.literal: Joshua recorded these things in the Book of the Law of God Then he took a large stone and set it up there under the oak that was near the sanctuary of the LORD
verses.literalPt: Josué escreveu essas palavras no livro da lei de Deus; tomou uma grande pedra e a pôs ali debaixo do carvalho que estava no santuário de Jeová.

verses.original: וַיֹּ֨אמֶר יְהוֹשֻׁ֜עַ אֶל־ כָּל־ הָעָ֗ם הִנֵּ֨ה הָאֶ֤בֶן הַזֹּאת֙ תִּֽהְיֶה־ בָּ֣נוּ לְעֵדָ֔ה כִּֽי־ הִ֣יא שָׁמְעָ֗ה אֵ֚ת כָּל־ אִמְרֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבֶּ֖ר עִמָּ֑נוּ וְהָיְתָ֤ה בָכֶם֙ לְעֵדָ֔ה פֶּֽן־ תְּכַחֲשׁ֖וּן בֵּאלֹהֵיכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: way·yō·mer yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’el- kāl- hā·‘ām hin·nêh hā·’e·ḇen haz·zōṯ tih·yeh- bā·nū lə·‘ê·ḏāh kî- hî šā·mə·‘āh ’êṯ kāl- ’im·rê Yah·weh ’ă·šer dib·ber ‘im·mā·nū wə·hā·yə·ṯāh ḇā·ḵem lə·‘ê·ḏāh pen- tə·ḵa·ḥă·šūn bê·lō·hê·ḵem
verses.literal: And Joshua said to all the people You see this stone It will be a witness against us for it has heard all the words the LORD has spoken to us and it will be a witness against you if you ever deny your God
verses.literalPt: Disse Josué a todo o povo: Eis que esta pedra será testemunha contra nós, porque ela ouviu todas as palavras que Jeová nos falou; será testemunha contra vós, para que não negueis o vosso Deus.

verses.original: וַיְשַׁלַּ֤ח יְהוֹשֻׁ֙עַ֙ אֶת־ הָעָ֔ם אִ֖ישׁ לְנַחֲלָתֽוֹ׃פ
verses.transliteration: way·šal·laḥ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ ’eṯ- hā·‘ām ’îš lə·na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw
verses.literal: Then Joshua sent the people away each to his own inheritance
verses.literalPt: Assim, despediu Josué ao povo, cada um para a sua herança.

verses.original: וַיְהִ֗י אַֽחֲרֵי֙ הַדְּבָרִ֣ים הָאֵ֔לֶּה וַיָּ֛מָת יְהוֹשֻׁ֥עַ בִּן־ נ֖וּן עֶ֣בֶד יְהוָ֑ה בֶּן־ מֵאָ֥ה וָעֶ֖שֶׂר שָׁנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: way·hî ’a·ḥă·rê had·də·ḇā·rîm hā·’êl·leh way·yā·māṯ yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ bin- nūn ‘e·ḇeḏ Yah·weh ben- mê·’āh wā·‘e·śer šā·nîm
verses.literal: Some time later . . . . . . Joshua son of Nun the servant of the LORD died at the age . . . of 110
verses.literalPt: Depois dessas coisas, morreu Josué, filho de Num, servo de Jeová, tendo cento e dez anos de idade.

verses.original: וַיִּקְבְּר֤וּ אֹתוֹ֙ בִּגְב֣וּל נַחֲלָת֔וֹ בְּתִמְנַת־ סֶ֖רַח אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּהַר־ אֶפְרָ֑יִם מִצְּפ֖וֹן לְהַר־ גָּֽעַשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw biḡ·ḇūl na·ḥă·lā·ṯōw bə·ṯim·naṯ- se·raḥ ’ă·šer bə·har- ’ep̄·rā·yim miṣ·ṣə·p̄ō·wn lə·har- gā·‘aš
verses.literal: And they buried him in the land of his inheritance at Timnath-serah in the hill country of Ephraim north of Mount Gaash
verses.literalPt: Sepultaram-no no termo da sua herança, em Timnate-Sera, que está na região montanhosa de Efraim, da banda do norte do monte Gaás.

verses.original: וַיַּעֲבֹ֤ד יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־ יְהוָ֔ה כֹּ֖ל יְמֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֑עַ וְכֹ֣ל׀ יְמֵ֣י הַזְּקֵנִ֗ים אֲשֶׁ֨ר הֶאֱרִ֤יכוּ יָמִים֙ אַחֲרֵ֣י יְהוֹשֻׁ֔עַ וַאֲשֶׁ֣ר יָדְע֗וּ אֵ֚ת כָּל־ מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר עָשָׂ֖ה לְיִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃
verses.transliteration: way·ya·‘ă·ḇōḏ yiś·rā·’êl ’eṯ- Yah·weh kōl yə·mê yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wə·ḵōl yə·mê haz·zə·qê·nîm ’ă·šer he·’ĕ·rî·ḵū yā·mîm ’a·ḥă·rê yə·hō·wō·šu·a‘ wa·’ă·šer yā·ḏə·‘ū ’êṯ kāl- ma·‘ă·śêh Yah·weh ’ă·šer ‘ā·śāh lə·yiś·rā·’êl
verses.literal: Israel had served the LORD throughout the days of Joshua and . . . of the elders who outlived . . . . . . him and who had experienced all the works that the LORD had done for Israel
verses.literalPt: Israel serviu a Jeová todos os dias de Josué e todos os dias dos anciãos que ainda viveram depois de Josué, e sabiam todas as obras que Jeová havia feito a favor de Israel.

verses.original: וְאֶת־ עַצְמ֣וֹת י֠וֹסֵף אֲשֶׁר־ הֶעֱל֨וּ בְנֵי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֥ל׀ מִמִּצְרַיִם֮ קָבְר֣וּ בִשְׁכֶם֒ בְּחֶלְקַ֣ת הַשָּׂדֶ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר קָנָ֧ה יַעֲקֹ֛ב מֵאֵ֛ת בְּנֵֽי־ חֲמ֥וֹר אֲבִֽי־ שְׁכֶ֖ם בְּמֵאָ֣ה קְשִׂיטָ֑ה וַיִּֽהְי֥וּ לִבְנֵֽי־ יוֹסֵ֖ף לְנַחֲלָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’eṯ- ‘aṣ·mō·wṯ yō·w·sêp̄ ’ă·šer- he·‘ĕ·lū ḇə·nê- yiś·rā·’êl mim·miṣ·ra·yim qā·ḇə·rū ḇiš·ḵem bə·ḥel·qaṯ haś·śā·ḏeh ’ă·šer qā·nāh ya·‘ă·qōḇ mê·’êṯ bə·nê- ḥă·mō·wr ’ă·ḇî- šə·ḵem bə·mê·’āh qə·śî·ṭāh way·yih·yū liḇ·nê- yō·w·sêp̄ lə·na·ḥă·lāh
verses.literal: And the bones of Joseph which the Israelites . . . had brought up out of Egypt were buried at Shechem in the plot of land that Jacob . . . had purchased from the sons of Hamor Shechem’s father for a hundred pieces of silver So it became an inheritance for Joseph’s descendants
verses.literalPt: Aos ossos de José, que os filhos de Israel trouxeram do Egito, sepultaram-nos em Siquém, no pedaço de campo que Jacó comprou aos filhos de Hamor, pai de Siquém, por cem peças de dinheiro; e tornaram-se a herança dos filhos de José.

verses.original: וְאֶלְעָזָ֥ר בֶּֽן־ אַהֲרֹ֖ן מֵ֑ת וַיִּקְבְּר֣וּ אֹת֗וֹ בְּגִבְעַת֙ פִּֽינְחָ֣ס בְּנ֔וֹ אֲשֶׁ֥ר נִתַּן־ ל֖וֹ בְּהַ֥ר אֶפְרָֽיִם׃
verses.transliteration: wə·’el·‘ā·zār ben- ’a·hă·rōn mêṯ way·yiq·bə·rū ’ō·ṯōw bə·ḡiḇ·‘aṯ pî·nə·ḥās bə·nōw ’ă·šer nit·tan- lōw bə·har ’ep̄·rā·yim
verses.literal: Eleazar son of Aaron also died and they buried him at Gibeah which had been given to his son Phinehas in the hill country of Ephraim
verses.literalPt: Morreu também Eleazar, filho de Arão, e sepultaram-no no outeiro que a seu filho Fineias fora dado na região montanhosa de Efraim.
